say:1:1220502001:0.text: Little ones, have you seen any piglets near the village?
say:1:1220502001:0.source_cn: 小家伙，你们有没有在村子附近看到几只白净的小猪？

say:5:1220502003:0.text: Could they have been stolen by the Water Wights? With all the chaos before, it's anyone's guess what they managed to plunder.
say:5:1220502003:0.source_cn: 会不会是被水鬼帮掠走了？毕竟之前那么混乱，他们很可能趁...

say:6:1220502004:1.text: That's what I suspected. Those scummy Wights are surely at fault!
say:6:1220502004:1.source_cn: 我也是这么怀疑的。水鬼帮那群混蛋，绝对干得出来这种事！

say:7:1220502005:1.text: They used to come and raid our village all the time! There were so many this time that I was too busy protecting the others to look after my livestock. Curse them!
say:7:1220502005:1.source_cn: 以前他们就经常跑来侵扰我们村子！这一次要不是他们人多势...

say:8:1220502006:1.text: I'm sorry, but I can't waste any more time talking. I'm going to find their lair and make them—ouch!
say:8:1220502006:1.source_cn: 行了，我不和你们说了，我今天非得找到他们的老巢，把那里...

say:9:1220502007:1.text: Oh no! You're badly hurt! You need to rest and regain your strength!
say:9:1220502007:1.source_cn: ——呜哇！你也受了不轻的伤！还是好好休息，别激动比较好！

say:10:1220502008:1.text: How can I?! Even if I can't take on the Wights, I still need to get my piglets back and—ugh...
say:10:1220502008:1.source_cn: 那怎么行？！就算不教训水鬼帮，我也得去找我的那些猪——嘶……

say:11:1220502009:1.text: Please, now isn't the time for bravery or pride. You must rest.
say:11:1220502009:1.source_cn: 建议你不要逞强，养好身体才是最重要的。

say:12:1220502010:1.text: As for finding your piglets, just leave that to us!
say:12:1220502010:1.source_cn: 至于找猪这种小事，我们可以帮你！

say:13:1220502011:1.text: You're... truly willing to help me? The Wights are not ones to be taken lightly.
say:13:1220502011:1.source_cn: 这……你们真的愿意帮我？水鬼帮可不是好对付的。

choice_prompt:14:1220502011.text: You're... truly willing to help me? The Wights are not ones to be taken lightly.
choice_prompt:14:1220502011.source_cn: 这……你们真的愿意帮我？水鬼帮可不是好对付的。

say:15:1220502012:1.text: That's right! The Water Wights are no match for the Magister! Don't worry about a thing, madam!
say:15:1220502012:1.source_cn: 就是！区区水鬼帮，怎么可能是主人的对手！大婶，你就把这...
say:15:1220502012:1.male: That's right! The Water Wights are no match for the Magister! Don't worry about a thing, madam!
say:15:1220502012:1.female: That's right! The Water Wights are no match for the Magister! Don't worry about a thing, madam!

say:16:1220502013:1.text: Sorry for troubling you with this. There's a Wight camp on the <style="highlight">south side of the hill</style>, they probably took my pigs there.

say:17:1220502014:1.text: All I need are my animals safely returned. As for those scoundrels, I'll deal with them myself as soon as I can!
say:17:1220502014:1.source_cn: 你们只要帮我把猪带回来就行，至于那群混蛋，我迟早要亲自...

choice:14:0:1.text: It'll be a piece of cake.
choice:14:0:1.male: It'll be a piece of cake.
choice:14:0:1.female: It'll be a piece of cake.

choice:14:1:2.text: I mean, I did save you before...
choice:14:1:2.male: I mean, I did save you before...
choice:14:1:2.female: I mean, I did save you before...

say:0:1220503001:0.text: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!
say:0:1220503001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里有猪的脚印，而且像是被拖走的！
say:0:1220503001:0.male: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!
say:0:1220503001:0.female: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!

say:1:1220503002:0.text: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!
say:1:1220503002:0.source_cn: 我们沿着痕迹向前，应该就能找到劫走它们的水鬼帮了！
say:1:1220503002:0.male: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!
say:1:1220503002:0.female: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!

say:0:1220504001:0.text: This pig is too stubborn! I can't get it under control!
say:0:1220504001:0.source_cn: 这头猪也太倔了！根本控制不住！

say:0:1220505001:0.text: Found them! The Water Wights definitely stole the pigs!
say:0:1220505001:0.source_cn: 找到了！村民丢失的猪果然是被水鬼帮掠走的！

say:1:1220505002:0.text: So, you're here running errands for the widows, eh? You'd better get lost if you know what's good for you!
say:1:1220505002:0.source_cn: 原来是来替那帮寡妇算账的啊……哼，既然来了就别想走了！

say:1:1220508001:1.text: It's over... the angry pig scared all the little ones away!
say:1:1220508001:1.source_cn: 完蛋了……那只发怒的猪把其它小猪都吓跑了！

say:3:1220508002:1.text: Hey, relax! It looks like they ran in the direction of the village.
say:3:1220508002:1.source_cn: 先别紧张！看它们跑的方向，像是回村里去了。

say:4:1220508003:1.text: Chippy, any ideas on how to calm this big pig?
say:4:1220508003:1.source_cn: 满满，你有办法制服这只大猪吗？

say:5:1220508004:1.text: Huh?! Chippy is no pig whisperer!

say:6:1220508005:1.text: Then I suppose we should head back and ask its owner how to deal with it.
say:6:1220508005:1.source_cn: 要不然，我们先回去问问它的主人有没有驯服的办法？

say:7:1220508006:1.text: Chippy will stay here to keep an eye on that angry pig while you hurry to <style="highlight">Brineville</style> to find a solution!
say:7:1220508006:1.source_cn: 好像只能这样了……那满满留下来保护这只猪，免得它跑丢！...

say:0:1220509101:0.text: Sure enough, all the little pigs ran back to the village.
say:0:1220509101:0.source_cn: 果然，这些小猪都跑回村子里来了。

say:1:1220509102:0.text: What a mess! Quick, help me get them into the <style="highlight">pigsty</style>!
say:1:1220509102:0.source_cn: 真是乱了套了！快，快帮我把它们<style=highl...

say:1:1220510001:1.text: Alas, these little pigs are a handful! Just look at how much trouble they get up to...
say:1:1220510001:1.source_cn: 唉，我家这些小猪崽，就是不让人省心！真是给你们添麻烦了。

say:3:1220510002:1.text: There's still another pig in the Water Wights camp, but it's so angry that no one can get close to it!
say:3:1220510002:1.source_cn: 大婶，水鬼帮营地还有一只猪。但它一直在发怒，不肯让我们近身。

say:4:1220510003:0.text: Oh, you must mean the strongest piglet! No wonder I haven't seen it!
say:4:1220510003:0.source_cn: 哦，你说的肯定是最健硕的那只小猪！我说怎么没看见它呢！

choice_prompt:5:1220510003.text: Oh, you must mean the strongest piglet! No wonder I haven't seen it!
choice_prompt:5:1220510003.source_cn: 哦，你说的肯定是最健硕的那只小猪！我说怎么没看见它呢！

say:6:1220510006:2.text: That's easy! There's a bell in my house that my husband and son would use to train the piglets.
say:6:1220510006:2.source_cn: 这事好办！我家有个铃铛，是以前我丈夫和儿子拿来训练小猪...

say:7:1220510007:1.text: But... they've been gone for many years. Of the pigs we had back then, only this one remains. The others all came after.
say:7:1220510007:1.source_cn: 不过……唉，他们都离开好多年了。当时养的那些猪，也只剩...

say:8:1220510008:1.text: That bell hasn't been used in ages, and I've forgotten which box it's in. I'm afraid it won't be easy to dig up now.
say:8:1220510008:1.source_cn: 那铃铛很久不用，我都忘记收到哪个包裹里了。现在想找出来...

say:9:1220510009:1.text: Perhaps you could help me find it?
say:9:1220510009:1.source_cn: 你们要是不介意，就帮我一起找一下吧。

say:11:1220510004:0.text: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.
say:11:1220510004:0.source_cn: 叫习惯了而已。当年我丈夫养的第一批小猪里，就只剩下这一只了。
say:11:1220510004:0.male: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.
say:11:1220510004:0.female: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.

say:12:1220510005:0.text: That explains why it's bigger than the others. Is there anything we can do to tame it?
say:12:1220510005:0.source_cn: 难怪它的体型比其他小猪都要大呢。那有没有什么可以驯服它...

choice:5:1:2.text: Do you know a way to pacify it?
choice:5:1:2.male: Do you know a way to pacify it?
choice:5:1:2.female: Do you know a way to pacify it?

say:0:1220511001:0.text: It wasn't easy, but we found the bell.
say:0:1220511001:0.source_cn: 真不容易啊，可算把这铃铛又找出来了。

say:1:1220511002:0.text: We'll put it to good use and bring your pig back soon!
say:1:1220511002:0.source_cn: 有了它就没问题了，我们很快就把你的猪带回来！

say:0:1220512001:0.text: Chippy, we found a bell to tame the pig!
say:0:1220512001:0.source_cn: 满满，我们找到驯服大猪的铃铛啦~

say:1:1220512002:0.text: Great, let's get it home quickly! Chippy does not want to be glared at by it anymore!
say:1:1220512002:0.source_cn: 太好了，我们快点送他回去吧！满满实在不想被它继续瞪着了……！

say:1:1220513001:1.text: Miss, why did you come to the village gate?
say:1:1220513001:1.source_cn: 大婶，你怎么跑到村口来了？

say:3:1220513002:1.text: Just because I know how stubborn that old pig can be! Now that the village has calmed down, I thought I'd come and greet you.
say:3:1220513002:1.source_cn: 还不是因为这只猪脾气最倔！正好村里也安稳点了，我就想着...

say:4:1220513003:1.text: Thank you for helping me find them all! Now I can finally get some rest.
say:4:1220513003:1.source_cn: 多谢你们帮我找回它！现在我总算能安心歇一会儿了。

say:5:1220513004:1.text: Wait, don't forget to take this back! Your bell!
say:5:1220513004:1.source_cn: 啊，别忘记收好这个！你的铃铛！

say:6:1220513005:1.text: Ah... don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's a keepsake that reminds me of my husband and son...
say:6:1220513005:1.source_cn: 哎……不用担心，我会好好收着它的。不管怎么说，也是我丈...

choice_prompt:7:1220513005.text: Ah... don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's a keepsake that reminds me of my husband and son...
choice_prompt:7:1220513005.source_cn: 哎……不用担心，我会好好收着它的。不管怎么说，也是我丈夫和儿子留下来的遗物……

say:8:1220513006:1.text: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.
say:8:1220513006:1.source_cn: ……都过去多少年了，我早就没事了。
say:8:1220513006:1.male: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.
say:8:1220513006:1.female: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.

say:9:1220513007:1.text: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.
say:9:1220513007:1.source_cn: 再说了，我们这种靠海吃饭的人，早就知道会有这么一天。
say:9:1220513007:1.male: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.
say:9:1220513007:1.female: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.

say:11:1220513009:1.text: I'm sorry, we didn't mean to make you sad.
say:11:1220513009:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我们不是故意惹你伤心的……

say:12:1220513010:1.text: Yes, I'm sorry! Chippy didn't realize just how important this bell was to you.
say:12:1220513010:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！满满也不知道，这个铃铛对你这么重要……

say:13:1220513011:1.text: Oh, don't you be sorry! I made my peace long ago.
say:13:1220513011:1.source_cn: 行了，别往心里去！我早就接受现实了！

say:14:1220513012:1.text: But once in a while, when it's especially quiet... I still miss them.
say:14:1220513012:1.source_cn: 只不过，偶尔，很偶尔的时候……我还是会想他们。

say:16:1220513008:1.text: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.
say:16:1220513008:1.source_cn: 那可不是藏起来！不过是……我不想触景生情而已。
say:16:1220513008:1.male: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.
say:16:1220513008:1.female: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.

choice:7:1:2.text: You hide your pain so deeply.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 但你之前把它藏得很深
choice:7:1:2.male: You hide your pain so deeply.
choice:7:1:2.female: You hide your pain so deeply.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220507001:.text: Woah, why is that one so angry?!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220507002:.text: The piglets were scared away by it!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220514001:.text: If only they were still here...
